body: ac-00 (GATE, done): PRIZE — semantic over-emission mass (needs meaning not shape): gold 83 cols (9.0%, oracle UB 0.803->~0.89), repr 31 cols (12.0%, UB 0.691->~0.81). Breakdown gold: residual->specific 62 + geo/person 16 + currency 5. ORACLE upper bounds — realistic capture far less (determinability probe: even blind LLM panels resolve ~87% of contested). BUDGET — current marginal 0.9ms/col (Model2Vec+multibranch+duckdb, best-of-3, 1000-vs-100col diff); corpus pass ~99min. LM at ~10ms/col = 11x: every-column ~18h (OFF the table), low-band-only ~5.5h (VIABLE). REGIME DECISION: low-band-only escalation gated by the shipped quality_band<0.70; ceiling for ac-01 = <=10ms/col CPU quantised. Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/ac00_prize_and_budget.md. NOTE ac-01/02 need a Python torch/transformer env the eval venv lacks.

ac-01 (done): latency probe (CPU, single-col). static potion 0.05ms; all-MiniLM-L6-v2 6.7ms (CLEARS <=10ms low-band ceiling); bge-small 11.4ms (just over); Qwen2.5-0.5B decoder 69ms (interactive-only). VIABLE FAST CANDIDATE EXISTS: MiniLM-L6 at 6.7ms for low-band-only. Every-column still off the table (6.7ms x 6.6M = ~12h vs current ~1.6h).

ac-02 (GATE, done): GO — the semantic signal IS there in a richer encoder. Linear-probe 5fold acc on 244 contested cols (ZERO-SHOT, no fine-tuning): contextual encoders ~0.893 (MiniLM-L6 / bge-small) and Qwen2.5-0.5B 0.901 >> static Model2Vec/potion 0.803 >> shipped model 0.684. Contextual beats static by +9pp and the shipped model by +21pp. KEY: decoder LLM (0.901) barely beats small encoder (0.893) for 10x latency -> the boundaries are embedding-separable, a small encoder suffices; no decoder needed. CAVEAT (column-stats lesson): 0.893 is a separability CEILING for a discriminator-with-second-opinion (CV-trained on the same families), NOT a shippable threshold; fine-tuning is upside but a built model still faces the attractor (ac-03) + all gates. Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/{probe.py,probe_extended.py,probe_data.tsv}.

ac-03 (done): attractor risk — encoder upgrade is the FIRST bet targeting the root cause (the prior failures broadened catch-alls partly BECAUSE the static encoder couldn't separate RESIDUAL from country_code; the probe shows a contextual encoder CAN, 0.893 vs 0.803). So the 0-for-6 prior is genuinely more open than the falsified head-only/context-only bets that left the encoder static. NECESSARY NOT SUFFICIENT: residual-precedence (0096) is also training-dynamics; build needs precedence-aware training (class-balance / abstain outcome) + all 4 gates. Training design named in deliverable.

ac-04 (GATE, done): GO to a scoped BUILD-AND-GATE spec — first model-side GO after 0-for-6. all four axes met: small (MiniLM-L6 22M), local (embeddable+offline+deterministic), fast (6.7ms low-band-only; every-column off table), fine-tuned (0.893 is zero-shot, fine-tune is upside). Crux gate ac-02 passed (signal present, +21pp over model; decoder LLM not worth its cost). Prize up to +9pp gold/+12pp repr (oracle ceiling, realistic less). FRAMING: GO to build+gate NOT to ship — 6 retrains died at these gates; difference is a mechanistic reason (encoder is the liftable bottleneck) + zero-shot evidence. Corpus-honest gate remains arbiter. Recommended next spec: build finetype-minilm-encoder (fine-tune all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + precedence-aware residual + quality_band-gated low-band escalation + full scoreboard). Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/ac03_ac04_synthesis.md.
